scope: Fresh rereview of shared store summary requests, retained category strip position, rapid search navigation and account/refresh races

findings.title: Account changes can reuse an earlier account refresh before repository session isolation runs
findings.trigger: Load account A into the retained root feed, start a delayed A refresh, switch the same client to account B and request refresh again before A finishes.
findings.cause: The notifier returns _refreshRequest without checking owner. Its current-generation check only tests mounted and a numeric generation, and the provider does not observe account changes. The B call therefore never reaches the repository session check. Root feed providers are not auto-disposed; the app auth listener does not invalidate this feed on owner replacement.
findings.impact: A previous account response can update the current store list and like state after the account has changed, even if the new account explicitly refreshes during the pending read.
findings.suggested_direction: Observe the current account at feed/local-like ownership boundaries, invalidate the old generation and in-flight interests on owner replacement, reject old owner results, and preserve same-owner concurrent refresh sharing. Use the shared account source rather than adding per-scroll auth/storage work.
findings.regression_case: review: changing account during refresh must start a new owner generation

confirmed: Three search opens/closes while the root page-zero read is pending share one actual HTTP request; all four repository callers finish.
The manually browsed category strip retains 930.5 instead of returning to zero, with the vertical browse position also preserved.
All/recommended/travel/club return paths retain parent rows, filter and vertical position; closed search scopes reject reads and detach their controllers.
Six rapid animated search cycles with repeated open callbacks leave no search routes/scopes and return transient callbacks to zero.
Simultaneous parent/search refreshes share one transport; a later response from a disposed, differently filtered search does not replace parent rows.
A delayed previous-page error does not replace the latest filter refresh, reset loading flags or disturb its list snapshot.
Twenty disposed search scopes join the pending parent transport; all callers drain after completion and the parent next refresh obtains fresh rows.

Direct repository calls remain separated by session/account/page/size/search/category/price and release completed/failed request entries; mutation invalidation does not allow an older completion to evict its replacement.
LTR/RTL, large text, dark mode, hidden selection changes and hidden resize still reveal only when needed without moving the outer catalog.

sdk_fixture.changelog_and_api_verification: Current-day changelog and docs evidence retained in the previous fix report; no API/SDK changes made in this review.
sdk_fixture.execution: Actual SupabaseTemplateRepository and SupabaseClient with MockClient at fixture.invalid. Synthetic sessions are installed using the actual GoTrue SDK. Native JSON decoding and client shutdown complete before fixture disposal.

limits: The new failing test remains as a reproducible review regression; production code was not modified in this review turn.
Widget scopes, controllers, callbacks and transport lifecycle were tested under controlled response ordering. Real-device FPS, native heap/RSS peaks and OS/plugin behavior were not profiled.

No additional persistent route/controller leak was reproduced. Sharing bounds tracked keys at 32 but does not cancel network work that is already running; consumers may remain pending until their transport settles.
